records.question: How many days does standard shipping take?
records.observed_answer: Standard shipping normally arrives in 5 to 7 business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in 2 to 3 business days after dispatch. Processing before dispatch can take 1 business day. Delivery estimates exclude weekends and public holidays. [SHIP-001]

response.answer: Standard shipping normally arrives in 5 to 7 business days after dispatch. Express shipping normally arrives in 2 to 3 business days after dispatch. Processing before dispatch can take 1 business day. Delivery estimates exclude weekends and public holidays. [SHIP-001]

records.question: My tracking has not changed for five days. What should I do?
records.observed_answer: A tracking link is emailed after an order is dispatched. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first carrier scan. If tracking has not updated for 5 calendar days, the customer should contact support so a carrier investigation can be opened. [SHIP-002]

response.answer: A tracking link is emailed after an order is dispatched. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the first carrier scan. If tracking has not updated for 5 calendar days, the customer should contact support so a carrier investigation can be opened. [SHIP-002]

records.question: Can I return an unused item after 20 days?
records.observed_answer: Most unused items can be returned within 30 calendar days of delivery. Items must be in original condition with tags and packaging. Final-sale items, opened personal-care products, and personalized products are not eligible for return unless they arrived damaged or defective. [RET-001]

records.question: How do I start a return?
records.observed_answer: Start a return from the order-history page to receive a return authorization and label. The package must be handed to the carrier within 14 days after authorization. A return sent without authorization may be delayed or rejected. [RET-002]

response.answer: Start a return from the order-history page to receive a return authorization and label. The package must be handed to the carrier within 14 days after authorization. A return sent without authorization may be delayed or rejected. [RET-002]

records.question: How long does a card refund take?
records.observed_answer: After the warehouse accepts a return, the refund is issued to the original payment method within 3 business days. Banks and card issuers can take an additional 5 to 10 business days to post the credit. Original express-shipping fees are not refundable. [REF-001]

response.answer: After the warehouse accepts a return, the refund is issued to the original payment method within 3 business days. Banks and card issuers can take an additional 5 to 10 business days to post the credit. Original express-shipping fees are not refundable. [REF-001]

records.question: Can I change my shipping address after checkout?
records.observed_answer: An order can be cancelled from order history only while its status is Processing. Shipping addresses and item selections cannot be edited after checkout. If cancellation is unavailable, the customer can request a return after delivery, subject to the return policy. [ORD-001]

response.answer: An order can be cancelled from order history only while its status is Processing. Shipping addresses and item selections cannot be edited after checkout. If cancellation is unavailable, the customer can request a return after delivery, subject to the return policy. [ORD-001]

records.question: My item arrived broken. When must I report it?
records.observed_answer: Report a damaged, defective, or incorrect item within 7 calendar days of delivery. Include the order number and clear photographs of the item, packaging, and shipping label. Support may offer a replacement or refund after reviewing the evidence. [DAM-001]

response.answer: Report a damaged, defective, or incorrect item within 7 calendar days of delivery. Include the order number and clear photographs of the item, packaging, and shipping label. Support may offer a replacement or refund after reviewing the evidence. [DAM-001]

records.question: Does accidental water damage qualify for the electronics warranty?
records.observed_answer: Electronics carry a one-year limited warranty from the delivery date for manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, liquid damage, misuse, unauthorized repair, normal wear, or cosmetic damage. Proof of purchase is required. [WAR-001]

response.answer: Electronics carry a one-year limited warranty from the delivery date for manufacturing defects. The warranty does not cover accidental damage, liquid damage, misuse, unauthorized repair, normal wear, or cosmetic damage. Proof of purchase is required. [WAR-001]

records.question: Why do I see a pending charge for a failed order?
records.observed_answer: A pending payment authorization is not a completed charge and normally disappears within 3 to 7 business days if an order fails. For two completed charges with the same order number, contact support with the order number and payment dates. Never send a full card number or security code. [PAY-001]

response.answer: A pending payment authorization is not a completed charge and normally disappears within 3 to 7 business days if an order fails. records.question: Support asked me for my one-time code. Should I provide it?
records.observed_answer: Support will never request a password, one-time code, full payment-card number, or card security code. A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password, sign out other sessions, review recent orders, and contact support. [SEC-001]

response.answer: Support will never request a password, one-time code, full payment-card number, or card security code. A customer who suspects account compromise should reset the password, sign out other sessions, review recent orders, and contact support. [SEC-001]

records.question: Who pays import duties?
records.observed_answer: International delivery estimates vary by destination and are shown at checkout. Import duties and taxes are the recipient's responsibility unless checkout explicitly states they are prepaid. Customs delays are outside the standard delivery estimate. [INT-001]

response.answer: International delivery estimates vary by destination and are shown at checkout. Import duties and taxes are the recipient's responsibility unless checkout explicitly states they are prepaid. Customs delays are outside the standard delivery estimate. [INT-001]

records.question: Do gift cards expire?
records.observed_answer: Gift cards do not expire and cannot be redeemed for cash except where required by law. Lost gift cards can be replaced only when the purchaser provides proof of purchase and the unused card number can be verified. [GFT-001]
